articles.summary: Business Wire: U.S. Bank and DAT: Truck freight rates show modest uptick in early 2026. MINNEAPOLIS, April 01, 2026--The latest quarterly U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index – Rates Edition showed truck freight rates moving up modestly to start 2026, while the gap between spot and contract pricing has narrowed.
